title: 100% recommended experience
text: Highly recommended experience! I did the Gothic tour with friends who were visiting and already knew Barcelona, and even so, all of us—including me, who has lived in Barcelona for years—discovered new details, places, and facts. It's a great plan to discover the Gothic Quarter in a different way! The audio and games ensure that, thanks to the humor and the entertaining way of telling it, you don't forget what you have learned and seen minutes after finishing the tour. Without a doubt, a recommended experience! 🌟
author: rebecasantano

title: 100% recommended
text: One of the best tours I have ever done. Comprehensive, entertaining, and very innovative. Great to be able to do it at your own pace without schedules or guides
author: 813eudaldm

title: Self-guided tour with a touch of craziness, very cool!! and with very relatable language
text:
We did the Ciutat Vella tour for my birthday and it was a total success. We were a group of 4 people around 30 years old and we got really into the riddles. The language they use is super relatable and fun, nothing boring like dates that you forget in five minutes.
It is super comfortable because you go at your own pace. If you want to stop for a drink, you stop and then continue from where you left off in WhatsApp. It is like an escape room outdoors but with much more historical substance. We will definitely repeat with another of their tours.
author: Javier_A

title: A great plan with friends!
text:
An incredible plan with friends! We were looking for something different in Barcelona that wasn't the typical guide with the umbrella, and this exceeded our expectations. The mix of medieval history with that touch of dry humor made us laugh out loud while we explored the Gothic Quarter.
What we liked the most was the convenience of doing everything through WhatsApp. We didn't have to download any strange apps that would take up space; you simply open the chat and start. The tests force you to pay attention to details of the squares that we would have completely overlooked. Highly recommended
author: _ngelayjavib2026

title: Super fun experience
text: Highly recommended for couples! We did the Ciutat Vella tour last Saturday and we loved the experience. It is not the typical serious tour. They tell you things with a lot of charm and focus on the medieval period in a very enjoyable way. We discovered details about the Cathedral and the squares that we had never seen despite living here. The best part is that you are not dependent on anyone. Everything is managed through WhatsApp and the testing system is super efficient. It is ideal because you can pause to have a glass of wine at a terrace and then continue. A perfect plan!
author: mariacM8446KS
